blocks.title: Quick start
blocks.markdown:
1. Install the TrackMania ModLoader and tick **100 TMX Bingo Plugin** in your profile.
2. Start the game and press **F9**, then *Connection* and *Connect*. Approve the code on the page that opens.
3. Join a board on [100tmx.com](https://100tmx.com/events/bingo), pick it on the *Bingo* page in the game and drive.

blocks.title: ESWC Autosave
blocks.tagline: Every finish saved as a replay, and the online login error 12157 fixed, for TrackMania Nations ESWC.

items.title: Replays on their own
items.text: Every finish is saved as a normal .Replay.Gbx, without clicking Save replay.

items.title: TMX copy
items.text: On servers a second file keeps only your ghost and inputs, ready for TMX.

items.title: Online login fixed
items.text: Clicking Internet fails with error 12157 on Windows 10 and 11. The fix is for the game process only.

items.title: A tiny loader
items.text: A 4 KB dinput8.dll passes every DirectInput call on and loads the mod. Nothing else.

blocks.title: Requirements
blocks.markdown: It works with **one exe only**: the unofficial community patch of **TrackMania Nations ESWC 1.80** (the StarForce-free `TmNationsESWC.exe`, in-game version 0.1.7.9). With any other exe the mod does nothing and says so in its log.

items.a: Into GameData\Tracks\Replays\My Replays, named after the track and the time. Existing files are never overwritten.

items.q: There is no eswc_autosave.log after starting the game.
items.a: Then eswc_autosave.dll is missing or could not be loaded, and the game runs without the mod. Copy dinput8.dll, eswc_autosave.dll and eswc_autosave.ini next to TmNationsESWC.exe.

items.q: Does the online fix change Windows?
items.a: No. It allows TLS 1.0 and skips the revocation check for the game process only. Use a password for your ESWC account that you do not use anywhere else.

blocks.title: TrackMania Forever OpenXR
blocks.tagline: Play TrackMania Nations Forever and United Forever in VR, with a 3D world behind the menus.

items.title: Real VR
items.text: Stereo rendering through OpenXR for Steam Link, Virtual Desktop, SteamVR and other runtimes.

items.title: First person
items.text: Press 3 to drive from the cockpit. For United, the HD car skins from UVME look much better inside.

items.title: Settings in VR
items.text: F10 opens the VR settings menu while you play.

items.title: One click on or off
items.text: With TMLoader you switch the mod on and off without touching the game folder.

blocks.title: Installation video
blocks.caption: How to install the mod, by the author.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.markdown:
In the game options **turn off fullscreen and anti-aliasing**, and make sure the whole game window fits on your monitor. The mod checks this, shows a warning and stays on the desktop when something is wrong.

Set your OpenXR runtime (VDXR for Virtual Desktop, SteamVR's runtime for SteamVR). OpenXR layers that are not 32-bit, like ReShade, can cause trouble. The author notes that the mod crashes with Meta Horizon Link since v8: use Steam Link or Virtual Desktop instead.

The code of this mod is written entirely by an AI. The author says so in the README.

A fork with one patch by wial663 lets TM Vibrant Shaders run in VR: its menu shows in the headset, shading in VR is experimental. It is offered to this mod as a pull request; once merged, use the original.

items.q: The game stays on the desktop.
items.a: Fullscreen or anti-aliasing is still on, or the game window does not fit on the monitor. Fix the options and start again.

items.q: Shadows take very long when a map loads.
items.a: Cancel the calculation after a couple of seconds. CoreMod, which comes with TMLoader, makes it much faster.

items.q: Does it work with TM Vibrant Shaders?
items.a: Yes, the author shows it in a video in the README.

blocks.title: Good to know
blocks.markdown:
TwinkieForever is a **discontinued** fork of Twinkie. It needs the TrackMania ModLoader. The release is a Windows installer plus loose DLLs, not a zip, so the launcher can link to it but not install it with one click.

Hiding the in-game HUD can hide the Twinkie windows or make them look odd. Changing the shader quality usually fixes that. If you record with Medal.tv, turn on "Force Window Capture" there.

blocks.title: TrackMania ModLoader
blocks.tagline: Mod manager for TrackMania Nations and United Forever. It loads mods into the game without patching the exe.

items.title: Several mods at once
items.text: Runs TrackMania with multiple mods and keeps them updated automatically.

items.title: No exe patching
items.text: Injects DLL mods into the game without patching the exe.

items.title: Three downloads
items.text: An installer, a plain zip (for example for Linux) and a prepackaged zip with the common mods.

items.title: Mod servers
items.text: Shows the mods of the servers listed in its config.yaml, so authors can host their own mod lists.

blocks.title: Good to know
blocks.markdown:
ModLoader does not install TrackMania Forever itself; the game has to be installed first.

Because it injects DLLs into the game, browsers and antivirus programs may flag it. The author calls this a false positive and suggests adding the install folder (`%LocalAppData%\TMLoader\` by default) to the antivirus exceptions. Windows SmartScreen may show a blue warning because the installer is not signed.

The prepackaged zip has to be installed by hand in the game folder and does not update itself.

blocks.title: Mods that need it
blocks.markdown: TMInterface, Competition Patch 2.0, KimMod, CenterSpeed, Always Official, TMUnlimiter and many others are installed through ModLoader.

blocks.title: Credits
blocks.markdown: TrackMania ModLoader is made by Tomashu. This page follows the installation notes on his site.

blocks.title: TrackMania Competition Patch
blocks.tagline: Anti-cheat patch for TrackMania Nations and United Forever, with server validation of runs.

items.title: Anti-cheat
items.text: Prevents cheating such as replaying pre-made runs and slowing down the game time.

items.title: Validated runs
items.text: Runs driven with the patch and a stable connection are validated by the server and eligible for TMX.

items.title: Red timer
items.text: Without a connection the game timer turns red and the replay is not validated.

items.title: Little data
items.text: It sends only a small amount of data at the start and at the end of a race, not continuously.

blocks.title: Install and requirements
blocks.markdown:
The patch is installed through the TrackMania ModLoader. It needs the newest game version (2.11.26 or later) and a stable internet connection. For the Steam version, the page recommends installing the standalone game first.

If the connection drops during a run, the patch waits a few seconds at the end of the race and tries to validate again.

The patch is meant to give better protection against cheating and extra validation of records on important TMX categories such as Official Campaigns and Classic tracks.

blocks.title: Credits
blocks.markdown: Initially developed by donadigo. Competition Patch 2.0 was developed by Tomashu, the developer of ModLoader.

blocks.title: TMInterface
blocks.tagline: TAS tool for TrackMania Nations and United Forever: replay, analyse and modify runs with scripts, save states and bruteforce.

items.title: Race speed
items.text: Change the race speed, with deterministic playback of full input sequences.

items.title: Save states
items.text: Native save states and fast forward.

items.title: Bruteforce
items.text: A bruteforce script that changes inputs to improve a metric you define.

items.title: AngelScript API
items.text: Plugins hook into the game simulation; the documentation covers callbacks, settings and custom commands.

items.title: Commands and keys
items.text: A command system with bindable commands, plus input visualization.

blocks.title: Not for leaderboards
blocks.markdown: The author states that TMInterface is not meant for cheating or unfair play and has security features for that. Every run driven with it counts as a tool-assisted run, even if no inputs were injected, and does not belong on public leaderboards.

blocks.title: Install
blocks.markdown: TMInterface is available directly in the TrackMania ModLoader. The guide on the site covers installation, scripting, save states, bruteforce and the plugin API.

blocks.title: Credits
blocks.markdown: TMInterface is made by donadigo.

blocks.title: CenterSpeed
blocks.tagline: Speedometer for TrackMania Nations and United Forever: your speed in the middle of the screen or on the license plate.

items.title: Speedometer
items.text: Speed in the middle of the screen, or drawn on the license plate of the car.

items.title: Checkpoint times
items.text: Speed and time at each checkpoint, with the difference to your best run.

items.title: Live tracking and spectating
items.text: Compare against another player online and see speed and times of the player you spectate.

items.title: Settings on F8
items.text: Size, position, gears, RPM bars and plate settings per environment.

blocks.title: Install
blocks.markdown:
1. Install the TrackMania ModLoader and start it once.
2. Add `https://fullspeed.mooo.com/modloader/` under the servers in `%LocalAppData%\TMLoader\config.yaml`.
3. Install CenterSpeed from the list and tick it. ModLoader installs CoreMod, which CenterSpeed needs, by itself.

Updates arrive automatically each time ModLoader starts.

blocks.title: Credits
blocks.markdown: CenterSpeed is made by OneCredit.

blocks.title: Always Official
blocks.tagline: Keeps restarting Official mode in TrackMania United Forever after you entered it once.

items.title: Restart stays official
items.text: Retiring or pressing Improve starts official mode again without the confirmation.

items.title: Inputs carry over
items.text: Input presses are carried over, so you do not have to press them again.

items.title: Offline by default
items.text: A race is still offline until you use Restart in Official Mode.

items.title: Small
items.text: The first C# mod for the TMF ModLoader, built with NativeAOT at a little over 800 kB.

blocks.title: Good to know
blocks.markdown:
Coppers are consumed at the end of the countdown, so this is not a free official mode.

The recommended install is through ModLoader: add the mod server URL from the README under `servers:` in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\TMLoader\config.yaml`. A standalone build with a d3d9.dll proxy also exists, but it can collide with other mods.

blocks.title: Credits
blocks.markdown: Always Official is made by BigBang1112.

blocks.title: TrackMania Highlands
blocks.tagline: The first community environment for TrackMania United Forever.

items.title: New environment
items.text: Adds Highlands as a new environment to TrackMania United Forever.

items.title: Install from the ZIP
items.text: TM Horizon checks TmHighlands.zip from ModDB, backs up the two game files it replaces and unpacks it. Undo puts them back.

items.title: On and off
items.text: Switch Highlands off without uninstalling: the environment and the car are set aside until you switch it on again.

blocks.title: Install
blocks.markdown: Download **TmHighlands.zip** (about 650 MB, 1.55 GB unpacked) from the ModDB page and open the game page of United Forever: the card *Recommended for your game* finds the file in Downloads. Only the GameData folder is unpacked; the readme and credits from the ZIP are shown before you install. Highlands replaces *Game.FidCache.Gbx* and the *BaseEditorSimple* campaign; TM Horizon keeps both, and Undo in History restores them.

blocks.title: Credits
blocks.markdown: TrackMania Highlands is made by the TrackMania Modding Community, 2021–2025, some rights reserved. Project lead: **St1ngLeR** (environment, vehicle, skins, physics), with more modellers named in *Highlands Credits.txt* inside the ZIP. The community Discord is linked in the readme.

items.text: After each finish a replay link that TMX accepts, because TMX only takes server-saved replays.

items.title: Reports and presets
items.text: Impossible and hard map reports, genre presets and votes for maps and presets.

items.title: Runs 24/7
items.text: Offline map pool, watchdogs, and several servers on one machine.

blocks.title: Where it comes from
blocks.markdown:
A fork of Randomizer Anywhere by BigBang1112, which starts a dedicated server and runs a Random Map Challenge controlled by chat commands. This fork runs the three public servers of the 100% TMX project.

It is a .NET console app. No builds are distributed; the live servers run from source builds. For ESWC, a chat hint points players to the ESWC Autosave mod instead of a replay link.

blocks.title: Credits
blocks.markdown: Fork by cheatoskar of Randomizer Anywhere by BigBang1112. Work in progress.

blocks.title: Nostalgic Completionist
blocks.tagline: Console app that queues random unfinished TMX tracks for TrackMania Nations ESWC, Sunrise and Original.

items.title: Two modes
items.text: Finish unfinished tracks, or beat unbeaten author times; it skips on a saved replay.

items.title: Batches from TMX
items.text: Downloads a batch of random tracks and pushes them to the track list of a LAN server.

items.title: Replay copies
items.text: Accepted replays are copied to a folder per session for upload.

items.title: Ban list
items.text: A ban file per game excludes tracks for good.

blocks.title: Notes
blocks.markdown:
The app connects to the running game through GBXRemote and detects finishes by watching the replay folder. It does not support Stunts, Platform or multilap tracks. For ESWC the game must be started before the app.

It was made for the 100% TMX project and is a fork of the project of the same name by BigBang1112.

blocks.title: Credits
blocks.markdown: Fork by cheatoskar of Nostalgic Completionist by BigBang1112.

blocks.title: DeltaZero
blocks.tagline: Research project: a driving AI for TrackMania Nations Forever trained by imitation and reinforcement learning.

items.title: Learns from replays
items.text: Pretrained with behaviour cloning on replays, then improved with reinforcement learning.

items.title: Track geometry
items.text: The policy sees nearby blocks and a planned route instead of screen pixels.

items.title: Headless physics
items.text: Uses the TMNF-C simulator to re-simulate runs without the game client.

items.title: Script export
items.text: Exports runs as TMInterface scripts for replay in the game.

blocks.title: Status
blocks.markdown: DeltaZero is a research project written in Python with PyTorch. It talks to the game through TMInterface 2.x and an AngelScript plugin, so it runs from source and is not installed into the game.

blocks.title: Credits
blocks.markdown: Made by cheatoskar. Uses TMInterface by donadigo and TMNF-C by adonis-singh.

blocks.title: Trackmania Map MCP
blocks.tagline: Experimental prototype that lets AI assistants build Trackmania Forever maps through the Model Context Protocol.

items.title: Turtle DSL
items.text: A relative movement language (forward, turn, slope, checkpoint) instead of absolute coordinates.

items.title: GBX bridge
items.text: Writes .Challenge.Gbx files with GBX.NET into a template Stadium map.

items.title: MCP tools
items.text: Tools to inspect maps, search blocks, validate and compile tracks.

blocks.title: Limits
blocks.markdown:
The README calls it an experimental proof of concept. The generated maps are very basic and mostly unsuitable for real driving: there is no physics or momentum validation and no library of track segments.

It needs Node.js 20 or later and .NET 8.

blocks.title: Credits
blocks.markdown: Made by cheatoskar. Uses GBX.NET by BigBang1112.

blocks.title: TrackMania Competition Patch
blocks.tagline: Anti-cheat patch for TrackMania Nations and United Forever, with server validation of runs.

items.title: Anti-cheat
items.text: Prevents cheating such as replaying pre-made runs and slowing down the game time.

items.title: Validated runs
items.text: Runs driven with the patch and a stable connection are validated by the server and eligible for TMX.

items.title: Red timer
items.text: Without a connection the game timer turns red and the replay is not validated.

items.title: Little data
items.text: It sends only a small amount of data at the start and at the end of a race, not continuously.

blocks.title: Install and requirements
blocks.markdown:
The patch is installed through the TrackMania ModLoader. It needs the newest game version (2.11.26 or later) and a stable internet connection. For the Steam version, the page recommends installing the standalone game first.

If the connection drops during a run, the patch waits a few seconds at the end of the race and tries to validate again.

The patch is meant to give better protection against cheating and extra validation of records on important TMX categories such as Official Campaigns and Classic tracks.

blocks.title: Credits
blocks.markdown: Initially developed by donadigo. Competition Patch 2.0 was developed by Tomashu, the developer of ModLoader.

blocks.title: ForeverTAS
blocks.tagline: Community TAS client for TrackMania Nations and United Forever that runs the game physics outside the game.

items.title: Own physics
items.text: Runs the deterministic physics of ForeverValidator outside the game.

items.title: GPU search
items.text: Bruteforce input search on NVIDIA or AMD GPUs.

items.title: Windows and Linux
items.text: A Windows installer and a Linux AppImage.

items.title: Updates
items.text: The first download runs everywhere and offers the matching GPU package on launch.

blocks.title: Status
blocks.markdown: ForeverTAS is an alpha release and is listed with the other TAS tools on TMTAS Exchange. Like every TAS tool, runs made with it are tool-assisted and do not belong on public leaderboards.

blocks.title: Credits
blocks.markdown: ForeverTAS is maintained by Skycrafter (Skycrafter-dev).

zipInstall.note: TmHighlands.zip from ModDB, checked 2026-11-11: 2,752 entries, about 1.55 GB unpacked, no programs. GameData/ is merged into the TMUF game folder; Highlands README.txt and Highlands Credits.txt stay in the ZIP and are shown. It overwrites GameData/Game.FidCache.Gbx and GameData/Tracks/Campaigns/BaseEditorSimple/BaseEditorSimple.ConstructionCampaign.Gbx; the History entry keeps both, Undo restores them. Off without uninstalling: the environment collection and HighlandCar are renamed to *.disabled (as the readme describes).
